clause_i.reason: False for this configuration. clause_ii.reason: True as a standalone clause: the static rendered cells, elevation labels, boxes, and hearth are visible, and a zero-width/latest frame would be sufficient; the visual window is unnecessary because the route is fixed.

clause_iii.reason: False. There is no autonomous non-clock task-state evolution during any positive wait. Waiting can consume the overall deadline, but deadline-only loss is excluded by the definition, so no D, Delta, and w can produce the required strict Q loss.
